issues.description: The UML and problem text specify that Animal.name is of type String, but the solution implements the field as a StringBuilder. This is an attribute type mismatch between the specification and the provided solution. While the solution's getter and setter expose String (so functionality is preserved), the difference from the UML could confuse students reviewing the solution or expecting to implement the attribute as String as instructed.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Animal.name field use type String to match the UML and problem description (e.g., private String name;), or update the problem/UML to explicitly state that a StringBuilder is used. Prefer changing the solution to use String to avoid student confusion.
